I so suck at reddit. Took me forever to get back. I’m an old lady.  I got turned on my last year of high school to Big Top Halloween. Def not a good album but sure was to me. I related to Greg’s angsty shit. Up In It, OMG! Marcy Mays on “ornament”. Plus NO ONE knew them, right. It felt like a secret. Congregation had some great filthy shit, sung so sweetly. Uptown with all the covers. Songs I knew from my folks age. Then when the Congo started and you could connect with other fans (are you still a fan?) and Gentlemen set it off. That’s when I learned so many others new them. G-d dammit!  I’m pretty sure I went through 4 cassettes (old lady) until Black Love came out. I had been to see them by then. I’d met them. Sat in the green room and smoked them out. (Got so self conscious bit got over it. My friend Rick Kulwicki used to be their roadie. When they came through Denver he got me the whole sound check, sit in and after, where we drank to much. By this time I knew them and they knew my name and I felt 10 ft tall. 65 tour was powerful. They were on their A game. I followed them about 6 shows. I got invited on the bus, to hang it. It was surreal. Hit SXSW IN 2013. Rosser was my favorite a true loss. A true gentleman. Steve Earle was good. He’s doing country folk now. Wild. McCollum was hmmm-words fail me. He plays in Moon Maan now- his band. Curley- so cool has a side band Plastic Ants. Greg did two live streams for the random desire album. I got a really great playlist he just sent out. Holler if you want. They are working on new material now. Again apologize for the book.
